changes.comment: BREAKING: Rename the pre-stable TeamMate, Team, and collaboration-space admin socket methods to product namespaces without compatibility aliases; remove the unsupported public dreamux dispatcher add/remove commands and their admin registry entries; and add persistent admin-only custom skill sources for TeamMate and TeamLeader creation. Dreamux-owned MCP tools keep their existing model-facing surface; direct admin clients must use canonical method names.
